verified: Deco row: NDL / TTS, DECO red, SAFETY boxed green, SAFETY / PAUSED, SAFETY / CLEAR, boxed CLEAR counter (manual Rev H5 p.13, p.25-26)
Banner notices: WARNING / INFO with a CLEAR tab (p.25-26)
Yellow above the stop, flashing red above the ceiling (p.26)
Standard page: depth, deco row (NDL / stop, TTS), info row O2/He | PPO2, dive time, rows divided (manual Rev H5 p.11, p.14)
CC page: the Standard layout with the CC badge (green; BO yellow), info row O2/He | SP with SP green high / magenta low, PPO2 there on a bailout; Auto SP Up notice (p.12, p.14, p.33-34)
Info pages: the Standard page with its info row replaced by one info screen each, cyan titles over white values, no column divider (manual Rev H5 p.16)

Info: AI as the T1 & GTR/SAC screen (p.17); MAX / AVG (p.17); CNS / MOD / PPO2, DilPO2 in place of PPO2 on the loop (p.16, p.18); GF / GF99 / SurfGF (p.18); TEMP / BATTERY (p.19); mBar NOW / SURF (p.19); TIME (p.19)
Gauge page: GA badge, depth, MAX | STOPWATCH, AVG | TIME, dive time, rows divided (Big layout figure, p.35)
Info: TIME / EOD - EOD is the time now plus TTS (Teric p.19)
assumed: Banner size and position on the Big layout; the HIGH PPO2 banner wording
Standard and CC pages: row positions and font sizes measured from the manual's figures, not a device photo; the info row shows its default items
Info pages: three-column positions and the % / unit marks placed by eye from the p.16-19 strips; TEMP with one decimal, MOD in the circuit's breathed gas (the diluent on the loop)
Info: BATTERY shows the log's battery value as a percent; Shearwater exports record battery voltage, not percent
Gauge page: STOPWATCH is the dive time (a log records no stopwatch reset); the bottom row shows the dive time where the surface figure shows SURFACE; positions measured from the p.35 figure
not_shown: Info screens LAST DIVE (surface only), Compass (no heading in the logs), TISSUES, CEIL / @+5 / Δ+5 (what-if values not computed) (p.16-20)
Gauge page: the battery icon and the surface interval (p.35)
